**7B.8 Research Note**

Verdict: mixed, leaning positive on formal commitments. Lula repeatedly used public, rule-bound messaging and some technocratic appointments, but there are serious caveats: he did not retract the Gaza/Holocaust comparison, pressured the central bank and Petrobras, used official channels to suppress health-disinfo, and his fiscal messaging drew repeated credibility critiques.

- **Lula says those who financed, planned, and executed the coup attempt should be punished** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-08 | [recoverable page](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) | He treated the January 8 attack as real and called for punishment rather than denial or minimization. That supports keeping a public commitment to constitutional order. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7
- **Lula and Blinken discuss peace in Ukraine and Gaza** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-02-21 | [recoverable page](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm) | Lula publicly presented his position as peace-oriented and anti-war, and the Planalto reiterated that line. This is evidence of consistent messaging rather than opportunistic reversal. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.2
- **Brazil says it will not retract Lula Gaza comments** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-02-20 | [recoverable page](https://theprint.in/world/brazil-will-not-retract-lulas-gaza-comments-in-diplomatic-row-with-israel-sources/1972033/) | The government chose not to retract a highly controversial comparison after backlash. That is strong evidence against correction and against respecting the tradeoff between rhetoric and credibility. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.2, 7B.6
- **Lula repeats genocide accusation in Gaza row** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-02-23 | [recoverable page](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm) | He doubled down instead of walking the claim back, which is the clearest counterexample to admitting error or correcting an overstated public claim. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.2, 7B.6
- **Lula says government does not interfere with the Federal Police or judiciary** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-01-30 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/30/lula-rebate-acusacoes-de-bolsonaro-sobre-operacao-da-pf.amp.htm) | Lula denied interference and said police actions were under court orders. It is self-serving, but it is direct pro-commitment evidence on institutional restraint. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7
- **Lula to nominate Gabriel Galípolo as central bank chief** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-28 | [recoverable page](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764) | The nomination looked technocratic rather than personalist, with a serving central-bank official and finance-ministry background. That supports honoring formal process over loyalty politics. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.5, 7B.6, 7B.7
- **Lula nominee emphasizes freedom in decision-making** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-08 | [recoverable page](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lulas-nominee-to-head-brazil-central-bank-emphasizes-freedom-in-decisionmaking-3653485) | Galípolo told senators Lula guaranteed him decision-making freedom. That cuts against the idea of appointing a yes-man to hide tradeoffs. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.5, 7B.6, 7B.7
- **Lula’s government is committed to fiscal responsibility** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-07-03 | [recoverable page](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-says-government-is-committed-to-fiscal-responsibility-3507587) | Haddad said Lula ordered the team to comply with the fiscal framework and approved spending cuts. This is strong evidence of keeping a stated macro commitment even when costly. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **Lula pledges fiscal responsibility “to the letter”** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-03 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/03/responsabilidade-fiscal-e-compromisso-do-governo-e-sera-mantida-a-risca-diz-lula.htm) | Lula publicly reaffirmed rule-bound fiscal management and said he would avoid economic shocks while preserving transfers. That supports keeping formal commitments, though later events weakened credibility. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **Lula says he will choose the next central bank head carefully** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-07-16 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/16/ainda-nao-tenho-nome-para-presidir-bc-vou-escolher-na-hora-certa-diz-lula.amp.htm) | He described the process as careful and consultative with Haddad, which is more consistent with formal selection than opportunistic reversal. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.5
- **AGU removes false claims about Lula’s health from YouTube** | Advocacia-Geral da União | 2024-12-16 | [recoverable page](https://www.gov.br/agu/pt-br/comunicacao/noticias/youtube-retira-do-ar-desinformacao-sobre-estado-de-saude-do-presidente-da-republica/) | The administration used official channels to force removal of videos making false claims about Lula’s health. That may be defensible, but it is also active state management of public information. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.2, 7B.7
- **Brazil digital news report: fake-news bill and hourly-fine threat** | Reuters Institute | 2024-06-17 | [recoverable page](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/brazil) | The report says the government’s platform bill was abandoned after the justice minister threatened hourly fines when Google opposed it. This is the strongest evidence of pressure on the information environment. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.2, 7B.7
- **TCU prosecutor seeks inquiry into possible Petrobras interference** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-18 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm) | The prosecutor argued dividend decisions might have been driven by government preference rather than economics. This is the clearest caveat for concealed tradeoffs and strategic-firm steering. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.4, 7B.5, 7B.6, 7B.7
- **Pressure on Petrobras dividend policy** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-03-20 | [recoverable page](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/20/fazenda-insiste-com-lula-por-aval-a-dividendo-extra-da-petrobras.amp.htm) | Reuters reported pressure on Lula to block extraordinary Petrobras dividends and redirect funds to investment/fiscal uses. That is a real sign of politically convenient state-resource steering. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.4, 7B.5, 7B.6
- **Lula does not immediately remove indicted minister** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-06-13 | [recoverable page](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/13/lula-diz-que-tomara-decisao-sobre-juscelino-filho-e-que-indiciamento-nao-significa-que-ministro-cometeu-erro.amp.htm) | Lula delayed action after indictment of a politically connected minister, which weakens the clean-commitment signal and suggests tolerance of patronage risk. IDs: 7B.8, 7B.5, 7B.6

Search gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence of Lula directly lying about a formal promise in the electoral sense, but I did find repeated credibility problems around Gaza rhetoric, fiscal messaging, and information control. The main pattern is not wholesale abandonment of commitments, but selective opacity and defensiveness when the political costs were high.
